name: iColo Maputo One MPM1
notes: Operational carrier-neutral colocation facility in Maputo; iColo official page lists 80-rack capacity, 9,500 sqm campus, 350 sqm IT space, and network connectivity; Digital Realty official page lists Maputo colocation services. Club of Mozambique reported opening on 2023-02-13.

name: Raxio Mozambique MZ1
notes: Operational Tier III facility in Matola, Beluluane Industrial Park; Raxio official page states up to 400 racks and 3 MW IT power. MozParks reported inauguration in 2024.

name: Vodacom Matola Data Center
notes: Tier III data center in Matola/Tchumene, Maputo Province, inaugurated 2025-03-28/31; INTIC says initial phase has 128 racks, expandable to more than 500, with SEACOM, 2Africa, and EASSY connectivity. DCD reported $25m investment; INTIC valued it at over 600m meticais.

name: Africa50-financed Maputo data center and Maluana rehabilitation
notes: Africa50 signed memorandums with the government to finance a data center in Maputo and rehabilitation of the Maluana data center in Maputo Province. No MW capacity disclosed.

name: Maluana Science and Technology Park data center
developer: Government of Mozambique / Maluana Science and Technology Park
notes: U.S. International Trade Administration says the Government of Mozambique operates Maluana Park and four other data centers; UNCTAD notes Maluana STP is commercializing its data centre. 360 Mozambique/Lusa reported planned rehabilitation under Africa50 package in 2025.

name: BCX Maputo data center
notes: DCD reported Alibaba Cloud Africa Local Public services are hosted in a BCX data center in Maputo; BCX official Mozambique page confirms Maputo headquarters and nationwide operations, but does not publish facility capacity.

name: SEACOM Maputo CLS data center
notes: Aggregator listings identify SEACOM Maputo CLS at Av. Marginal, Maputo, offering colocation; Inflect lists 280 kW power capacity and 175 kW cooling. No primary operator spec located in this pass.

name: Teledata Mozambique Data Center
notes: Aggregator listings place Teledata's colocation data center at Avenida 24 de Julho, Maputo. Capacity not publicly identified in located sources.

name: Nacala-Porto 2Africa cable data center
notes: 2Africa launch in Nacala-Porto included opening of a data center by project partner Master Power Technologies; DCD says facility details were not disclosed. Treated as Nampula Province based on Nacala-Porto location.
